identity: Whitebridge sells the same river basket twice while poachers, wolves and wetland collectors each claim a toll.

quests.title: The Waiting Still Eat
quests.text: People have paid for baskets that never reached their tables, and a refund will not cook itself tonight. Bring me eight Corn for the waiting households. Whitebridge Market Close should be remembered for feeding its customers.

variants.text: People have paid for baskets that never reached their tables, and a refund will not cook itself tonight. Bring me eight Corn for the waiting households. Whitebridge Market Close should be remembered for feeding its customers.

I count the cutting crews out and count them home, and while they wait for the next shift they still need to eat. Bring me eight Corn for them. A full crew is a fine thing; a crew that is full is better.

quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Vorrat für die Wartenden'.

quests.title: Have the Ramp Measured
quests.text: That ferry ramp takes loaded carts, so 'looks about right' is not a measurement I will accept. Speak to Halen Chalkthumb at Bridgechalk Dig about the repair it needs. Tell him Jessa wants a ramp that carries the load all the way to the other end.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Two Pickups for One Basket
quests.text: Two customers are waving pickup slips for the same basket, and each thinks the other is the thief. Check the pickup records by the stored baskets here at Whitebridge Market Close and bring your findings to me. I would like to know which order is genuine before the argument damages the goods.
quests.completion: This is the original order; the other slip promises a basket its seller had no right to offer. I can put the rightful buyer beside the goods and help the other customer pursue their payment. Neither should have had to fight their neighbour over lunch.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Thorn Sells It Twice
quests.text: Basket-Poacher Thorn sells the same basket to two buyers and leaves my market to settle the shouting. Kill Thorn in the {name:willowbanks}, {dir_from_giver:basket_poacher_thorn}, and bring me word. The customers paid for food, and his only contribution was a second receipt.
quests.completion: Thorn will make no more promises over our baskets. I will help the customers sort out their purchases; they have lost enough without losing trust in one another.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Stone for the Ferry Ramp
quests.text: The ferry ramp has to carry a cart's weight while its wheels are moving, a detail the old repair rather overlooked. Bring me twenty Stone Bricks for the supports. I have allowed for a full load and a driver who insists on bringing one more sack.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Other End of the River Trade
quests.text: Ilwen Petalmeasure sends harvest loads from Lorindor, and I need to know what leaves her hands as well as what reaches mine. Speak to her at Lorindor Berrycourt about the river trade. Two people keeping honest accounts ought to be able to find where a basket goes missing.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: One Basket on Two Accounts
quests.text: The double sales here have buyers wondering which promises they can trust. Take word of them to Dorrin Gateledger in Dur Brannoc. He should hear what those slips cost people before another one arrives looking respectable.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Baskets for the Cold
quests.text: Edda Tarnmantle at Tarnwatch Fold in Frostbarrow Shelf depends on these deliveries, and cold weather is a poor time to discover a basket is only a promise. Go and ask what her people are waiting for. I would rather hear about an empty shelf while we can still fill it.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Murk's Final Fare
quests.text: Mirefolk Ferryman Murk charges carters for the passage they need, then finds a fresh fee once the load cannot turn back. Kill him at the {name:ferry_camp}, {dir_from_giver:ferry_camp}, and report to me. A ferryman earns a fare by carrying people across; Murk earns his by keeping them there.
quests.completion: Murk is down, and the carters can get their loads through without his next demand. I will see that word reaches them before someone pays him in advance.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Measures for Splitbolt
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt needs sound judgement at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights, where a bad measurement can land heavily. Go and speak to him about the work. A careful pair of eyes is worth more there than a confident estimate.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
